device_entry.name: USB-CTR04/08 多通道标度计数器
tags: 同步计数与探测器通道监测
瞬态信号采集与同步触发测量
device_entry.description: Measurement Computing 的 USB-CTR04/USB-CTR08 多通道标度计数器，用于对脉冲或计数通道进行定时采集。该设备支持内部/外部模式、连续采集、标量采集、阵列采集和 ROI 模式，可启动、停止、清除并读取 MCS/MCA 数据，常用于步进扫描或连续扫描实验中的计数信号采集。
device_entry.description_en: Measurement Computing USB-CTR04/USB-CTR08 multi-channel scaler for time-resolved pulse or count acquisition. It supports internal and external modes, continuous, scaler, array, and ROI acquisition modes, and can start, stop, erase, and read MCS/MCA data for step-scan or slew-scan experiments.
